title: TN-Eval: Rubric and Evaluation Protocols for Measuring the Quality of Behavioral Therapy Notes
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the quality of medical notes in the behavioral health domain using a clinical rubric (SOAP format). The term 'faithfulness' in this context refers to factual accuracy and grounding in the source transcript (i.e., avoidance of hallucinations) rather than religious or spiritual faith. It does not evaluate religion, spiritual traditions, or specific moral/ethical systems.
